title: task create: invalid option values exit 65 instead of 64
body: Repro: krn task create --title x --priority 9 exits 65 (invalid task data) with 'priority must be an integer between 0 and 3'; the same class of bad CLI input (--title missing, bad --status, bad --as) exits 64. Expected: exit 64 for invalid option values; 65 only for corrupt stored data. Same check for edit --priority. Also krn task create --title '' exits 65.
